answer_1.quote: In the context of neural machine translation (NMT), CR is important because it allows the model to move beyond simply recognizing patterns in the data and instead make more informed, nuanced translations.

answer_2.quote: We choose three representative automatic metrics (i.e., the sim(•) function) for calculating the similarity: the most widely-used BLEU and the two powerful PT-based metrics BLEURT and BERTSCORE.

answer_4.quote: The evaluation involves two bilingual experts who are asked to label whether an NMT candidate is commonsensible, with the assistance of the right and contrastive references in the testset.
answer_4.guideline: Label whether an NMT candidate is commonsensible, with the assistance of the right and contrastive references.
